sn13.1:1.1: The root sense of _abhisamaya_ is “gathering”, as a group of brahmins for a congress (Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 3.1.1), or as breaths to a dying man (4.4.1), or as blessings like winnings to the good (Chāndogya Upaniṣad 4.1.4). The English word “gather” also takes the sense “understand”, but not in such a deep sense. In Buddhism, it acquires the technical sense of the “comprehension” of the Dhamma at least at stream-entry.
